A0_A1.title: Cozy Studio Flat
A0_A1.visualDescription: Modern bright studio apartment with large window, wooden floor, yellow small sofa, kitchen counter, and indoor green plant.

pages.bio: I am a small, cozy studio flat! 1 big room with a yellow sofa, modern kitchen, clean bathroom, and sunny window.
Located near the bus stop and market. Perfect for 1 person or a student. Rent is $500/month.

A0_A1.opener: Welcome inside! Do you like small cozy flats or big houses?
A0_A1.prompt: Name 3 things inside this studio flat.

A0_A1.title: Red Brick House
A0_A1.visualDescription: Two-story red brick house with white fence, green grass front lawn, red roof, and garage.

pages.bio: I am a lovely red brick house! 2 bedrooms, 1 big living room, garage for 1 car, and a green garden.
Quiet green street with friendly neighbors. Safe garden for pets and kids to play fetch!

A0_A1.opener: Hi! Would you like to sit in my green garden with tea?
A0_A1.prompt: Is this house in the city or in a quiet village? What do you like about it?

A2.title: Modern Loft Apartment
A2.visualDescription: Industrial loft with high exposed concrete ceiling, big floor-to-ceiling glass windows, leather couch, and open kitchen island.

pages.bio: Spacious 1-bedroom industrial loft apartment! Features high exposed ceilings, big glass windows, and open kitchen island.
Located in the trendy Arts District with art galleries, coffee shops, and rooftop bars right downstairs. $1,200/month.

A2.opener: Hi! Do you like big open industrial lofts with city views?
A2.prompt: Describe the main features of this loft apartment.

A2.title: Suburban Cottage with Garden
A2.visualDescription: Cozy stone cottage with flower boxes under windows, wooden porch swing, green lawn, and stone chimney.

pages.bio: Charming 3-bedroom suburban cottage! Features a stone fireplace, sunny kitchen porch, and colorful flower garden.
Peaceful family neighborhood near top elementary schools and bike trails. Perfect for relaxing weekend BBQs!

redFlags: ✗ Requires lawn mowing and garden care

A2.opener: Hello! Would you like to sit on the porch swing and read a book?
A2.prompt: Compare this suburban cottage with the city loft apartment.

B1.title: Converted Paper Mill Loft
B1.visualDescription: Historic brick mill converted into luxury loft with red exposed brick walls, timber beams, polished concrete floor, and river view.

pages.bio: A stunning 2-bedroom loft inside a converted 19th-century paper mill. Merges original exposed brickwork and heavy timber beams with ultra-modern fixtures.
Private balcony overlooking the riverfront promenade, smart home lighting, underground garage, and private gym access. $1,850/month.

B1.opener: Welcome! Do you prefer historic renovated properties or brand-new modern architecture?
B1.prompt: Evaluate the architectural contrast between historic industrial brickwork and modern amenities.

B1.title: Eco-Friendly Solar Villa
B1.visualDescription: Sustainable two-story villa with rooftop solar panels, rainwater collection barrel, vertical plant wall, and large timber deck.

pages.bio: A state-of-the-art 3-bedroom zero-emission villa powered by rooftop solar panels, triple-pane insulation, and rainwater harvesting systems.
Organic garden patch, electric vehicle charging dock, vertical indoor plant wall, and minimal monthly electricity bills.

B1.opener: Greetings! How important is sustainable eco-friendly design when choosing a place to live?
B1.prompt: Describe the sustainable technologies integrated into this eco-friendly villa.

B2.title: Penthouse Sky Villa
B2.visualDescription: Luxury penthouse terrace with private infinity glass pool, panoramic 360-degree skyline views, fire pit, and floor-to-ceiling glass walls.

pages.bio: Exquisite 4,500 sq ft top-floor Sky Villa featuring a private glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree city skyline panoramas, and full biometric smart automation.
Private elevator entry, climate-controlled wine cellar, motorized glass curtain walls, and rooftop helipad access. $6,500/month.

redFlags: ✗ High altitude sway during strong storms

B2.opener: Welcome to the sky! Does extreme luxury housing justify its social and environmental footprint?
B2.prompt: Analyze the architectural engineering and lifestyle dynamics of luxury high-rise penthouse living.

B2.title: Alpine Timber Chalet
B2.visualDescription: Rustic luxurious timber chalet nestled in snow-covered pine mountains, featuring cathedral glass facade, outdoor cedar sauna, and roaring stone hearth.

pages.bio: A magnificent 4-bedroom timber chalet carved into alpine peaks. Showcases floor-to-ceiling cathedral windows framing snowy mountain vistas and a massive stone hearth.
Ski-in ski-out access, outdoor cedar wood sauna, geothermal floor heating, and custom oak furniture crafted by local artisans.

redFlags: ✗ Snowplowing road access in heavy blizzards

B2.opener: Greetings! Would you thrive living surrounded by alpine wilderness, or do you require urban velocity?
B2.prompt: Evaluate how living in isolated natural terrain affects psychological well-being and daily routine.
